output.question: What are Restaurant Brands International's subsidiaries?

passages.quote: We are the sole general partner of Restaurant Brands International Limited Partnership, which is the indirect parent of The TDL Group Corp. (“TDL”), Burger King Company LLC (“BKC”), Popeyes Louisiana Kitchen, Inc. (“PLKI”), and FRG, LLC (“FRG”).

We franchise and operate quick service restaurants serving premium coffee and other beverage and food products under the Tim Hortons ® brand (“Tim Hortons”), fast food hamburgers principally under the Burger King ® brand (“Burger King”), chicken under the Popeyes ® brand (“Popeyes”), and sandwiches under the Firehouse Subs ® brand (“Firehouse”).

output.answer: Restaurant Brands International’s principal disclosed operating subsidiaries include The TDL Group Corp., Burger King Company LLC, Popeyes Louisiana Kitchen, Inc., and FRG, LLC. Its 2025 annual report identifies these entities as indirect subsidiaries of Restaurant Brands International Limited Partnership, of which RBI is the sole general partner. The latest quarterly report reviewed, covering September 30, 2026, identifies RBI’s restaurant brands as Tim Hortons, Burger King, Popeyes and Firehouse Subs.
caveats: This summarizes principal operating subsidiaries, not every holding company, regional entity or other subsidiary. The legal names come from the 2025 annual report; the September 2026 quarterly report confirms the brand portfolio rather than a complete updated legal-entity list.
